leaves.label: Release isolated – gas disperses without ignition
Prolonged release disperses without ignition – plant gas-out
Vapour cloud explosion – blast damage, multiple fatalities
Jet fire – isolated quickly, local damage
Prolonged jet fire – escalation to heaters / filter-separators
Unburnt gas burns off in the hot furnace – trip and relight
Fuel shut off – furnace purged and relit
Gas removed through the stack – post-purge, investigate
Deflagration relieved by explosion doors – burner / refractory damage
Furnace explosion – casing / door failure, potential fatalities

threats.name: PRS-1 active regulator fails open – MP header overpressure
External corrosion of buried sections and pipe supports
Mechanical impact – vehicles, mobile cranes, excavation
Flange, gasket or small-bore fitting failure
Maintenance / pigging error – wrong isolation, receiver opened under pressure, hot work
Regulator diaphragm / pilot venting inside the PRS shelter

cons.name: Prolonged jet fire – escalation to heaters / filter-separators
Large flash fire from a prolonged release
Vapour cloud explosion – blast damage to PRS / control room, multiple fatalities
Gas migration into buildings / cable trenches – confined explosion

barriers.name: PRS-1 overpressure protection – monitor regulator + slam-shut
Coating + cathodic protection with annual CP / DCVG survey
Thickness monitoring at supports, crossings and low points
Crash barriers and height gantries at pipe-rack road crossings
Ground-disturbance permit with buried-services drawing
Gasket control, bolt-torque procedure and leak survey
Small-bore fitting bracing and vibration survey
Permit-to-work with isolation verification, gas-free test and fire watch
Pig-receiver closure pressure-warning device / key interlock (PR-1001)
Pilot / diaphragm vents piped to vent stack VS-1301 outside the shelter
Gas detection and ESD isolation (GD-1110A/B/C 2oo3, UCP-1000, ESDV-1001 / ESDV-1107)
Ignition source control – Ex equipment, hot-work permit, vehicle control
Sealed cable-trench entries and building pressurisation near the MP header

threats.name: Burner flame failure / failed light-off with fuel flowing, furnace below auto-ignition temperature
Safety shut-off valves passing into the idle, cold furnace
Loss of combustion air with gas still flowing (fuel-rich)

cons.name: Furnace explosion – casing / door failure, potential fatalities
Deflagration relieved – burner / refractory damage, outage
Burns from flame blow-back at peep-holes / burner ports

barriers.name: BMS flame-failure shut-off (BS-4010, BMS-4000, XV-4002A/B)
Valve proving VPS-4004 before light-off (DBB vent XV-4003)
Positive isolation (spade) for extended shutdowns and furnace entry
BMS pre-purge interlock (proven air flow, ≥ 4 volume changes)
Light-off procedure and checklist (no manual torch lighting)
Low-low combustion air flow trip FSLL-4008
Furnace draught / post-purge removes unburnt gas before it ignites
Explosion relief doors on the furnace roof / walls
No-go zone around burner platforms during light-off
